record.question: Average annual rainfall ranging to dessert to hilly region would be __
record.explanation: Verified on the printed source (JE Technical Paper-I, March 2020, page 5, Q. 48): the stem and all four options match the bank exactly, including the printed unit 'cm'. Across the desert-to-hilly rainfall gradient the upper figure is about 2,500 (i.e. ~250 cm, the order quoted for Mizoram's monsoon rainfall of about 250 cm/yr), whereas 500, 820 and 1100 correspond to semi-arid/plains-scale values rather than the hilly end of the range. The stem itself is defective ('dessert' for 'desert', 'ranging to' for 'ranging from', and a single blank for what is a range), so the choice is the hilly-region figure of 2,500 rather than a fully unambiguous item.
